task.title: Product B: Dosage Administration
task.shortdesc: Instruction for administering Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV.

prereq.p: Confirm patient's eligibility for Product B treatment.

context.p: Take this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, call your care team immediately.

step.cmd: Calculate the total dose of Product B based on the patient's weight (2 mg/kg).
step.stepxmp: For example, a 70 kg patient requires a total dose of 140 mg (70 kg × 2 mg/kg).

step.cmd: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection before administration.
step.stepresult: Make sure that the IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.

step.cmd: Administer Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV over 10 minutes.
step.info: Monitor patient's vital signs and adjust dosage as necessary.

step.cmd: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection after administration.
step.stepresult: Make sure that the IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.
